title: [DEV] "PH" gets added in Treatments history when manual bolus (not delivered by pump)
symptom: When performing a manual bolus with 'do not bolus, record only' from AAPSClient or AAPS, or via the AAPSClient Calculator, the treatment history gets 'PH' added instead of only 'NS'.
cause: The issue is that the original fix did not include a check for a temporaryId when pumpId is null, leading to 'PH' being added.
fix: The fix was applied in commits 275e52a546791ff044121bce6984a778b724a2c6 and ccabee0399d33427ffa8837e53d6756d569e99b5, which likely add a check to exclude entries with temporaryId and null pumpId.
evidence_quote: Is it an idea to make the original fix https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/394883165d2f6603286d7bb56f6312d8b742c3b8 include a check if there is a temporaryId and pumpId is null to then exclude it ?
